report_title: Alba Palm Beach - Buyer-Facing Building Overview

source_urls: Official Alba site, official residences page, official amenities page, official team page, Florida YIMBY, Miami Residence, Distinctive Palm Beach Properties, active Zillow/Redfin/Realtor listing pages.
building_type: Boutique waterfront condominium with tower residences and a limited number of townhome residences.
parking_summary: Assigned parking is listed by the official amenities page; public listings show garage parking, often one space for smaller residences.
storage_summary: Official amenities include private storage units, bicycle storage, package room and cold storage lockers.
pet_summary: Pet-friendly with restrictions. Official amenities include a dog spa / grooming station and private secure dog run; Distinctive notes "pet policy: yes, with restrictions."
buyer_cost_notes: Confirm exact HOA, reserve contribution, insurance treatment, parking/storage assignments, dock/slip terms, pet limits, and lease restrictions before offer. HOA estimates vary by listing and may change after turnover.
bedroom_range_display: 2- to 4-bedroom residences; 4-bedroom townhomes are also referenced in public materials.
floorplan_count: Not publicly summarized in one source; official site offers downloadable floorplans.
floorplan_status: Released / available through downloads and active listings.
residence_features: Spacious layouts with water views from all residences; den/media room in most plans; oversized glass-framed terraces; summer kitchens on all terraces; floor-to-ceiling hurricane impact windows; hurricane impact sliding doors; Italkraft kitchens; Sub-Zero and Wolf appliances; spa-like baths.
outdoor_space_summary: Oversized private terraces with panoramic views and summer kitchens. Select townhomes include multi-level terraces and private plunge pools.
view_exposure_notes: Direct Intracoastal frontage with no fixed bridges to the Atlantic Ocean and unobstructed views. Public listings and official materials reference Intracoastal, ocean, city, Palm Beach and downtown views.
elevator_entry: Private elevators and vestibules are referenced by Florida YIMBY; official amenity materials also reference touchless elevators by floor.
furnished_options: No standard furnished package found in public sources. Treat as unfurnished / designer-ready unless a specific listing says otherwise.
walkability_summary: Alba is directly on the Intracoastal in a quieter North Flagler / Northwood waterfront setting. It is not the most walkable downtown product, but it offers waterfront calm with quick car access to downtown West Palm Beach, Palm Beach Island, marinas, restaurants, museums and beaches. Official location copy frames beaches, dining, shopping, theater and yachting as "minutes away."
palm_beach_access_summary: Short drive to Palm Beach Island via North Flagler / Flagler Memorial Bridge. Official and broker materials emphasize proximity to beaches, Worth Avenue and Palm Beach.
boating_or_marina_summary: Strong boating angle. Official amenities include a private dock with boat slips; Florida YIMBY describes on-site private docks/boat slips reserved for owners; owners receive a complimentary one-year Palm Beach Yacht Club & Marina membership.
nearby_districts: Northwood, North Flagler waterfront, Palm Beach Island, Downtown West Palm Beach, Clematis, The Square / CityPlace, Nora, Palm Beach Yacht Club & Marina, Palm Beach Sailing Club.
distance_landmarks: Approximate: Palm Beach Island 5-10 min drive; Worth Avenue 10-15 min; The Square / CityPlace 10-12 min; Clematis 7-10 min; Brightline 8-10 min; PBI Airport 15-20 min; Nora 5-7 min. Distances should be measured later from 4714 N. Flagler Drive and labeled as driving/walking distance.

amenity_highlights: Covered porte cochère, art and relaxation garden, dramatic lobby, dog spa/grooming, secure dog run, mailroom with cold storage, private storage, assigned parking, bicycle storage, TechnoGym fitness, spa, private massage room, great room, cocktail lounge, private dining, wine storage, catering kitchen, outdoor BBQ, screening room, bocce, workspaces, conference room, sunrise pool, sunset pool, cabanas, private dock and slips.
service_summary: On-site security and surveillance, valet, staffed lobby, towel service, on-site property management, concierge services available for an additional fee.
brand_or_hospitality_partner: Not a hotel-branded residence. Lifestyle partnerships include Palm Beach Yacht Club & Marina one-year membership and wellness access through Mount Sinai New York-Concierge Care and Sollis Health, per Florida YIMBY.
wellness_summary: TechnoGym fitness overlooking the Intracoastal, spa with his/hers sauna, steam, cold shower experience, treatment room and lockers, private massage treatment room; Florida YIMBY also notes Mount Sinai / Sollis wellness access.
dining_summary: Private dining room with climate-controlled owners' wine storage, catering kitchen and bar for private events, outdoor entertaining kitchen with BBQ, and a resident-oriented gourmet market partnership with Chèvre.
guest_suite_summary: No dedicated guest suites clearly confirmed in the official sources reviewed. Verify in condo docs.
private_club_or_resident_lounge: Great room, cocktail lounge, entertainment spaces, private dining room, wine storage, screening room, workspaces and conference room.
concierge_valet_summary: Valet services, staffed lobby, on-site property management and concierge services available for additional fee.
developer: BGI Companies / Kenneth A. Baboun with Blue Road as co-development partner; official site identifies Scuba Club WPB, LLC as developer entity.
interior_designer: Spina O'Rourke + Partners per Miami Residence; official residence finishes include Italkraft kitchens.
landscape_architect: Schmidt Nichols, according to Florida YIMBY.
sales_team: Douglas Elliman Development Marketing handled exclusive sales at launch; current public site links to ONE Sotheby's as sales/marketing contact.
construction_team: Suffolk Construction is identified as general contractor by Florida YIMBY.
brand_partner: None. Lifestyle partners: Palm Beach Yacht Club & Marina; Mount Sinai / Sollis Health wellness access.
best_for: Buyers who want a boutique, direct-Intracoastal building with new-construction finishes, dock access, private terraces, and a quieter North Flagler lifestyle. Strong fit for boaters, seasonal owners, downsizers, and buyers who want water without South Flagler House pricing.
tradeoffs: Less downtown walkability than Mr. C, La Clara, or The Berkeley. Smaller amenity/social scene than large trophy towers. HOA and services still need line-by-line verification. Some third-party data conflicts badly, including a Distinctive page that appears to list incorrect unit count/floor count for Alba.
compare_against: Ritz-Carlton Residences WPB, Shorecrest, Olara, The Berkeley, Mr. C Residences, La Clara, Forté, South Flagler House.
buyer_questions_to_verify: What are exact HOA fees by line? What is included? What are the current pet restrictions? What is the minimum lease term? How many rentals per year? apples_to_apples_notes: Compare Alba against other North Flagler projects by actual waterfront status, dock access, parking/storage, HOA per square foot, and service level. Alba is not trying to be a South Flagler trophy tower; it is a smaller, quieter, water-first alternative.

Treat Distinctive as useful only for pet/rental-policy notation and amenity hints, not scale. Maintenance ranges also conflict across sources.
missing_or_unconfirmed: Exact HOA budget, reserves, lease restrictions, pet limits, boat slip rights/fees, storage rights, parking assignments, post-turnover association rules, and exact remaining developer inventory.
source_notes_public: Prioritized official Alba pages and Florida YIMBY for scale/team/construction; used active listing sites for current pricing and HOA examples; used Distinctive only where clearly labeled as policy shorthand and flagged conflicts.
